name: DDoS-Guard
countrySource: Chosen over Russia, where its other company serves Russian residents only, because IQWeb FZ-LLC of Dubai says in the agreement every other customer signs under the laws of the UAE that it "is a legal entity and managing company operating under well-known brand name DDoS-Guard" (https://ddos-guard.net/file/sladdg_en.pdf, header and clause 4.18).

server.source: Observed on 2026-11-16 on ddos-guard.net and ddos-guard.ru, and on www.technesis.ru and tilda-main-page.skillbox.tj, whose edges sit in DDoS-Guard's AS57724

cookies.name: __ddg*
cookies.source: https://ddos-guard.net/file/sladdg_en.pdf (clause 5.13: the provider adds cookies to track site visitors and their sessions in order to protect the site), and observed on 2026-11-16 on ddos-guard.net, www.technesis.ru and tilda-main-page.skillbox.tj (__ddg1_, __ddg8_, __ddg9_, __ddg10_, and __ddg5_, __ddgid_, __ddgmark_ on ddos-guard.net), set by the edge on the site's own domain

challengeHosts.source: Observed on 2026-11-16 (https://check.ddos-guard.net/check.js answers with server: ddos-guard and a script), and named as the host of the browser check in https://github.com/mikf/gallery-dl/issues/1779

challengePaths.source: Observed on 2026-11-16: the page of ddos-guard.net loads the script /.well-known/ddos-guard/check, which technesis.ru also serves with server: ddos-guard, and which sends its results to /.well-known/ddos-guard/mark/
